items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: Back here, I see Ronnie Matthews, he comes up and he says, "Hey, motherfucker."

ctx.x: Thank God I'm good friends with all the piano players back here. I am better friends with the pianists in New York than I am with the pianists in Los Angeles. I don't know what it is about Los Angeles, but there is a jealousy of some kind or something like that. Like, you take guys like Lou Levy, who's the guy that's got the triple organ from...? Well, you just go through 'em. And it's bullshit. They don't give you credit, they won't accept credit.
Back here, I see Ronnie Matthews, he comes up and he says, "Hey, motherfucker." You know... Or this or that, you know. Or I see Ray Bryant or...
